newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real returns rise.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real returns rise.

text.p: Mexico's 1,078-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 96.78168 UDIs and a real return of 7.21 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,092-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.87 percent.
Demand this week was 1.852 billion UDIs compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 7.41.
The 1,764-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 95.69450 UDIs and a real return of 7.05 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,778-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.79 percent.
Demand this week was 1.269 billion UDIs compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.08.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MXAAN.
